product.title: Zion/Kolob Ghost Town Slot Canyon Vistas Private Full Day

description.text: Discover Zion beyond the main canyon on a private full-day loop through Kolob Terrace Road, Grafton Ghost Town, and Peek-A-Boo Slot Canyon. Your guide combines back-road driving with short hikes to petroglyphs, lava-point vistas, and red sand dunes outside the park shuttle zone. This itinerary suits photographers and repeat visitors seeking Kolob country scenery without the Narrows crowds. Lunch stops and pacing remain flexible for your group.

highlights: Private full-day Kolob Terrace and backcountry loop
Petroglyph and Lava Point vista stops

start.description: Morning pickup from Springdale hotels or meet at the Kolob Terrace Road junction confirmed at booking.

end.description: Return to Springdale after the Lava Point or dune overlook finale.
